headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong top‑line expansion while others saw modest or slowing performance.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% growth, the weakest among the major players. Most peers delivered double‑digit growth, supported by AI‑related deals, but profit margins varied. Guidance was introduced or updated by HCLTech and Wipro, indicating a focus on managing expectations.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin pressure and guidance cuts
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue guidance, while operating margins slipped for some peers despite revenue gains.
